names: Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27
summary: Parcel P27 in OCII's Mission Bay open-space plan: the Long-Range Property Management Plan lists it as lot 8723-002 (15,246 sq ft) at the northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets. Pier & Point's outline is a small triangular wedge of about 1,029 m2 between the I-280 ramp and Owens St, about 86% inside that Assessor lot, drawn by hand rather than taken from the lot's boundary. OCII's September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P27' among the parcels Rec and Park will manage "when built"; no source read says it has been built, and in USDA NAIP imagery viewed 2026-09-29 the ground is a strip of dry grass and bare ground.

milestones.text: Not yet built: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P27' among the parcels RPD will manage "when built," distinct from the already-managed parcels listed alongside it

open_questions: Whether this parcel has been built is not known. OCII's September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation (slide 5) lists 'P27' among the parcels Rec and Park will manage "when built"; no later source read says it was built. USDA NAIP imagery viewed 2026-09-29 shows a strip of dry grass and bare ground here, which is not a source for completion either way.

The outline is a hand-drawn approximation, not the lot. About 86% of it lies inside Assessor lot 8723002, the lot OCII's plan names for P27, but it covers only 61% of that lot (1,029 m2 of 1,457 m2; the plan gives 15,246 sq ft, about 1,416 m2).
No source read gives this parcel a name beyond 'P27', or says who would operate it other than the September 2023 presentation's "RPD will manage ... P27 when built".
